description: Source code for a shader translator utility that compiles and processes shader files, supporting multiple shader types and output formats, with command-line options for configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, sets up shader compilation, and outputs results.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the shader translator utility.

methods.name: FindShaderType
methods.description: Determines shader type based on filename extension.

methods.name: CompileFile
methods.description: Reads shader source from file and compiles it using the provided compiler handle.

methods.name: LogMsg
methods.description: Logs messages with a standardized format.

methods.name: PrintVariable
methods.description: Prints details of a shader variable, including type and name.

methods.name: PrintActiveVariables
methods.description: Prints all active shader variables (uniforms, attributes, varyings).

methods.name: ReadShaderSource
methods.description: Reads shader source code from a file into memory.

methods.name: FreeShaderSource
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for shader source code.

methods.name: ParseGLSLOutputVersion
methods.description: Parses GLSL output version from string.

methods.name: ParseIntValue
methods.description: Parses integer value from string with default fallback.
